Create a window-spec structure

Source: R/window.R
window_spec.Rd

One record per window-function call extracted by ir_extract_windows(). This is the exact shape ast_window()'s specs take, produced here so ast_window() can consume a finished plan's specs directly with no reshaping.

Usage

window_spec(
  output_col,
  fn,
  value_col = NA_character_,
  order_cols = character(),
  order_desc = logical(),
  output_type,
  n = NA_integer_,
  default = NULL,
  na_rm = FALSE,
  input_type = NA_character_
)

Arguments

output_col

Character scalar, the synthetic temp column name this spec's result will be materialized under (e.g. "..win1..")

fn

Character scalar, the canonical window op name (e.g. "lag", "cumsum", "mean")

value_col

Character scalar, the (already-resolved-to-a-plain- column) name of the window function's "value" argument, or NA_character_ for a call with no value argument (n(), bare row_number())

order_cols

Character vector of order-by column names for this spec's frame: rank-family calls with a value argument default this to value_col itself (ranking a column inherently orders by that same column), UNLESS an explicit order_by=/order_by()/with_order() override (R/ir.R's ir_parse_with_order()) is present, in which case that wins for ANY window kind (shift/rank/agg)

order_desc

Logical vector, parallel to order_cols, TRUE for descending

output_type

GPU type string for this spec's result column

n

Integer scalar, an op-specific count argument (lag/lead's shift amount, nth's element position), or NA_integer_ if not applicable

default

An IR literal node (the op's constant fill/default value), or NULL if not applicable/not supplied

na_rm

Logical scalar, the call's na.rm = argument (roll_*(), and mean()/median() of a date); FALSE unless the call sets it

input_type

GPU type string of an integer sum()'s argument ("INT32" or "BOOL8"), NA_character_ for every other call; a lazy mutate() runs a call holding an INT32 sum at the verb (see window_spec_int_sum())

Value

A list with exactly these named fields
